description: Buyer check before paying an x402 seller: a signed verdict on one offer from what Agoranome already holds, with the Fair Offer block valid and certified or not, the pay-to seen for this host and since when, the price against listing and quote, verified deliveries, and which policy tiers the offer meets. With tx=, settlement proof after paying: the USDC transfer on Base, whether it matched the quote, and a buyer-side receipt for the commons. Use when an agent needs seller evidence as it pays. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
